name: agreement defaults
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT type)=5 FROM agreement WHERE type IN ('USER_AGREEMENT','PRIVACY_POLICY','MEDICAL_INFORMED_CONSENT','ACCOUNT_CANCELLATION_NOTICE','ABOUT_US') AND is_deleted=0

name: agreement type labels
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=5 FROM agreement WHERE is_deleted=0 AND ((type='USER_AGREEMENT' AND type_label='用户协议') OR (type='PRIVACY_POLICY' AND type_label='隐私政策') OR (type='MEDICAL_INFORMED_CONSENT' AND type_label='用户就诊告知及知情同意书') OR (type='ACCOUNT_CANCELLATION_NOTICE' AND type_label='注销须知') OR (type='ABOUT_US' AND type_label='关于我们'))

name: agreement create menu name
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM sys_menu WHERE id=3534 AND name='协议新增' AND perm='content:agreement:create'

name: decoration permissions
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT perm)=8 FROM sys_menu WHERE perm IN ('biz:decoration:cards:list','biz:decoration:cards:update','biz:decoration:promo-cards:list','biz:decoration:promo-cards:update','content:agreement:list','content:agreement:create','content:agreement:update','content:agreement:publish')

name: agreement create permission grants
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM sys_role r CROSS JOIN sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id AND rm.menu_id=m.id WHERE r.id IN (1,2) AND m.perm='content:agreement:create' AND rm.menu_id IS NULL

name: appointment capacity
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM appointment_config WHERE id=1 AND slot_capacity>=1 AND is_deleted=0

name: points rule
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM marketing_points_rule WHERE id=1 AND is_deleted=0

name: settlement configuration
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM distribution_settlement_config WHERE id=1 AND is_deleted=0

name: appointment query and configuration permissions
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT perm)=2 FROM sys_menu WHERE perm IN ('biz:appointment:query','biz:appointment:config')

name: appointment permission grants
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM sys_role r CROSS JOIN sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id AND rm.menu_id=m.id WHERE r.id IN (1,2) AND m.perm IN ('biz:appointment:query','biz:appointment:config') AND rm.menu_id IS NULL

name: active appointment order uniqueness
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='appointment' AND INDEX_NAME='uk_appointment_active_order' AND COLUMN_NAME='active_order_id' AND NON_UNIQUE=0

name: new user coupon type constraint
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND CONSTRAINT_NAME='chk_coupon_type' AND CHECK_CLAUSE LIKE '%NEW_USER%'
